notes: Loan-MIS analysis from TAT.sas: cleaning + PROC SQL KPIs (total disbursement, count, SLA %, lead funnel, monthly/daily MIS, branch/product/channel performance) + PROC MEANS for average TAT. The repo read the data via PROC IMPORT of a hardcoded SAS OnDemand path; here 40 real rows from loan_mis_project_dataset.csv are read inline via DATALINES so the bundle is self-contained (code-only runner uploads no data files). All downstream analysis is verbatim from TAT.sas. Captured: avg TAT 5.25 days, SLA 52.5%.
